facts.fact: Yuko 骑公司自行车穿过自成一镇的船厂送便当，太阳晒着头皮
facts.anchor: I was riding down a rambling road on a bicycle with a rusty chain, the sun burning my scalp

facts.fact: 后辈 Miu Unosawa 在旁抱怨太热怕皮肤晒伤，但脸与四肢异常苍白
facts.anchor: pedaled beside me, complaining with furrowed brows

facts.fact: 叙事者入职二十五年，起初怕船的尺度僭越人类分寸，想起母亲讲的巴别塔故事
facts.anchor: It reminded me of a story in the Old Testament that my mother had told me about

facts.fact: 几个月后叙事者明白：零件虽大，工人做的和小塑料模型没什么不同，于是松了口气
facts.anchor: what the workers were doing with them was not much different from making small plastic models

facts.fact: 敷衍的假笑只是叙事者与人打交道的习惯，并非觉得对方有趣
facts.anchor: Half-hearted smiles were just a habit

facts.fact: Miu 在食堂对女同事说：把性骚扰当成一种沟通就完全没问题
facts.anchor: as a form of communication, it’s no problem at all

facts.fact: Fujii 梳了梳花白头发、把双手搭上 Yuko 肩膀低语：这地方没有你不能运转
facts.anchor: then placed his hands on my shoulders and whispered

facts.fact: 工会约八百名会员每月缴 2,000 日元会费，Yuko 每周三五傍晚在预制板棚里管账
facts.anchor: About eight hundred union members paid monthly dues of 2,000 yen each
